title: Gerald Caussé
vital_facts: Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young adult.
Conscripted military service from 1985-86; served in NATO as a driver for a U.S. general.
Married Valerie Badin; Bern Switzerland Temple Aug. 5, 1986; Five children.
Equivalent of an MBA from ESSEC Business School; emphasis in finance and marketing.
High Priest Group Leader; Counselor in Stake Presidency; Stake President; Area Seventy.
First Counselor to the Presiding Bishop 2012-present
accuracy_caveat: Community-compiled biographies from gapages.com (offline since 2023). Recovered from the Wayback Machine. Cross-reference with official Church sources.
